# The client's supplied logo, base64-encoded.
#
# Some transports (and Git clones made without binary support) cannot carry a
# PNG. The build reads this file when src/assets/brand-logo.png is missing, so
# the logo is never lost. Regenerate with:
#   base64 -w 0 src/assets/brand-logo.png > src/assets/brand-logo.base64.txt
